title: Cluster membership in manifests diverges from canonical initiative definitions
description: Three manifests redefine cluster boundaries differently from the initiative's Section 9.4: Phase 3 expands Cluster C from {CA-3, CA-7, CA-12, CA-13} to 7 members and renames it. Phase 3 truncates Cluster E from 10 to 6 members. Phase 1 adds AC-8 to Cluster G (canonical: AC-1-6 only).
root_cause: The manifest generation step may recompute cluster membership based on the features present in a phase rather than strictly using the canonical cluster definitions from the initiative. When a cluster spans features that feel 'related', the generator expands membership beyond the canonical set.
recommendation: In Phase 3.3, cluster tables must use ONLY the canonical cluster definitions from Section 9.3/9.4 of the initiative. Never add or remove features from canonical clusters. If only a subset of a cluster's features are in a phase, show the subset but label the cluster correctly. Never rename clusters.
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Natural Clusters table
